claims.claim: Sauna heat sources and humidity differ; much research concerns Finnish-style bathing.
claims.limitation: Results cannot automatically transfer to other sauna types or populations.

claims.claim: Heat exposure increases heart rate and sweating.
claims.limitation: Session logs do not establish adaptation or improved fitness.

claims.claim: Finnish prospective cohorts associate sauna habits with cardiovascular outcomes.
claims.limitation: Observational associations cannot establish causality or predict individual benefit.

claims.claim: Sweating produces variable fluid losses; hydration merits attention.
claims.limitation: Personal fluid requirements cannot be inferred from these logs.

studies.title: Association Between Sauna Bathing and Fatal Cardiovascular and All-Cause Mortality Events
studies.verification: Citation and DOI checked on source bibliography; publisher retrieval unavailable.

evidence_limitations: Limited populations and differing protocols restrict generalization; no personal diagnosis, treatment, or risk-reduction estimate is supported.
